name: Kasuga Madoka
source:
A bright and kind girl, Madoka is also very confident in herself. She has a great body, naturally, and likes to show it off by wearing skimpy clothes, which makes her job as a bunny girl a perfect fit. Though she's everyone's friend and likes to kid around, she's very serious about [url=https://vndb.org/c60294]Kazuma[/url].

[From [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582992-do-you-like-horny-bunnies-2/faqs/34122]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
